body: I remain unseen but hold many things and when you are making a decision you consult me. What am I?
I ride, I ride; No tracks are left. I chop and chop; There are no chips left. He rides and rides; Turns around: There is no road left?
I rise up free the first and second time. But need me a third and I will cost you. What am I?
I roam through the lands hoping to rescue my love. I search high and low and will stomp on you if you get in my way! What am I?
I row quickly with four oars but never comes out from under my own roof. What am I?
I run around the city but I never move?
I run around the city but I never move. What am I?
I run around the streets all day. Under the bed or by the door I sit at night, never alone. My tongue hangs out, waiting to be fed during the day. What am I?
I run but never walk, I murmur but never talk, I go but never stop. What am I?
I run cold and hot, I look blue but am red?
I run cold and hot, I look blue but am red. What am I?
I run distances, often making many turns, yet I never move one foot. What am I?
I run over fields and woods all day. Under the bed at night I sit not alone. My tongue hangs out, up and to the rear, awaiting to be filled in the morning?
I run smoother than any rhyme, I love to fall but cannot climb. What am I?
I run through hills. I veer around mountains. I leap over rivers. And crawl through the forests. Step out your door to find me?
I run through hills. I veer around mountains. I leap over rivers. And crawl through the forests. Step out your door to find me. What am I?
I run up and down the stairs without moving. What am I?
I save lives on the ground an din the air. What am I?

I saw a fight the other day; A damsel did begin the fray. She with her daily friend did meet, then standing in the open street, she gave such hard and sturdy blows, he bled ten gallons at the nose; yet neither seemed to faint nor fall, nor gave her an abuse at all?
I saw a man in white, he looked quite a sight. He was not old but he stood in the cold. And when he felt the sun, he started to run. Who could he be? Please answer me?

I saw a strange creature. Long, hard and straight, thrusting into a round, dark opening. Preparing to discharge its load of lives. Puffing and squealing noises accompanied it, then a final screech as it slowed and stopped?
I saw the dead bring forth the living. I saw the living bring forth the dead. What did I see?
I say everything I hear to others around. I'm not an animal, nor part of the human race. I will, immediately, repeat after you; But only if my tail is in place. What am I?
I scream, you scream, we all scream. For what?
I scribble forms of the finest letter and repel elements of the harshest weather. I am an arrow-aimer and a dust-breaker?
I see what you see, feel what you feel and hear what you hear. I know all of your moves before you make them. I even know the moves you didn't make. What am I?
I shared by goats, devils and unicorns. What am I?
I shave every day but my beard stays the same. What am I?
I shift around, though always slowly. I never move more than a few inches at a time. A large movement by me can kill many people. I am huge, yet unseen by humans. What am I?
I shoot but never kills. What am I?
I shoot people, then blow them up. What am I?
I shrink smaller every time I take a bath. What am I?
I sit in a corner and travel around the world. What am I?
I sit in a corner while traveling around the world. What am I?
I sleep by day and fly at night but I have no feathers to aid my flight?
I sleep by day, I fly by night. I have no feathers to aid my flight?
I sleep by day, I fly by night. I have no feathers to aid y flight. What am I?
I sleep during the day and fly at night but I have no feathers to aid my flight. What am I?
I sleep when you are awake, I am awake when you fall asleep. I can fly but no feathers to aid my flight. What am I?
I smell like blue paint, pours like green paint and I look like a red truck. What am I?
I soar without wings, I see without eyes. I've traveled the universe to and fro. I've conquered the world, yet I've never been anywhere but home. What am I?
I sometimes lack reason but often rhyme. I'm not the best but a good way to pass time. What am I?
I sometimes run but cannot walk. You follow me around. What am I?
I spend most of my day eating white. When I am quick enough, I get rewarded with fruit and somethings blue. In a dark room with blue walls, I run from the ghost that roam the halls. What am I?
I spend the day at the window, go to the table for meals and hide at night. What am I?
I spin and hum, I'm your summer tool. Just flip the switch and I serve to cool. What am I?
I spit like bacon, am made with an egg, I have plenty of backbone but lack good legs, I peel like an onion but still remain whole. I'm long like a flagpole, yet fit in a hole?
I stand in one place yet I fill a whole room. I can be filled with molten rock and come in every hue. What am I?

I stand up tall and made of steel, with baguettes and garlic at my heel. I love the colours red white and blue but obviously not as much as you. I am a marvel for all to see, though to some I am a monstrosity! What am I?
I start in little but I end in full, you'll find me in half and complete?
